developed-bundle — scans bridges/developed/* at depth 1 AND depth 2 (the develop loop's <lineage>/{brain,day_N} layout) for any dir with a brain.json manifest; reads name/day/n_facts/vocab_size/n_grounded_codes from the manifest; id = repo-RELATIVE forward-slash path; sorts 'brain' first then day_N ascending
